equity.equity_measurement: SES is an area measure (district SAIPE poverty tertiles). NCES locale of school districts is rurality of non-human units and region is geography, so neither is treated as an SPD; 28%–60% of responses were unknown or missing.

notes: Design inferred as cross-sectional from the census-based telephone survey; no design is named. All comparisons are descriptive percentages with no tests or CIs. Rurality was excluded as an SPD because the units are school districts; a reader treating locale as rurality would add a 4-group side-by-side groupwise entry.
view_issues: Discussion says rural districts less frequently reported HVAC upgrades than other locales, but Table 2 shows rural 33.8% vs town 31.2%. 'Differences' are asserted with no test. The R version given (1.4.1106) is an RStudio version.
